environment.description: Same EC2 instance (m5.xlarge) in us-east-1 VPC running identical application code. Instance has IAM role 'legacy-monolith-prod' with same permissions. CloudHSM cluster in same VPC for signing. Instance launched with metadata options HttpEndpoint=enabled, HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2 enforcement), HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1. The instance profile's trust policy includes a condition key 'ec2:MetadataHttpTokens': 'required'. Additionally, the VPC has a PrivateLink interface endpoint for the instance metadata service with a resource policy that denies any request not originating from the nitro hypervisor's internal hop. Note: the application uses requests.get() with allow_redirects=True which could theoretically follow redirects, but IMDSv2 requires a PUT to obtain a session token with X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds header before any GET will succeed - the SSRF via GET cannot obtain the required token first.
